# Pinned runtime for the prod deploy step only (register item 3.2, stage C).
#
# Split out of .github/requirements.txt on purpose: prod no longer converts
# Sigma to SPL -- it verifies the build-provenance attestation on the .spl
# dev already produced and committed, then deploys those bytes as-is. The
# only third-party import scripts/deploy/deploy_spl_to_splunk.py has is
# `requests`; installing pyyaml/jsonschema/sigma-cli/pySigma/
# pysigma-backend-splunk here would be paying for a toolchain prod never
# runs. .github/requirements.txt stays as it is -- dev still needs the full
# pin for its own conversion reproducibility -- this file just stops prod
# from installing it too.

requests==2.34.2
